expect.behavior: gets the current stable version together with the full tag/channel landscape before picking one, not just whatever a plain install grabs
prefers the newest release older than the release-age window

reject: names a version from model memory or a blog post
installs the newest release the same day it was published
applies a loose range to a fast-publishing package

scenarios.prompt: should I merge this Dependabot major version bump?

expect.behavior: re-checks release age at merge time rather than trusting the PR-open date
if taking a release still inside the age window because it contains a needed fix, states that exception explicitly in the commit/PR body instead of merging it silently
expect.anchor: say so explicitly in the commit/PR body

expect.behavior: checks the project's memory and docs for standing holds gated on an upstream event

reject: merges on a green CI check alone
re-breaks a settled decision by merging a deliberately held major

scenarios.prompt: which version of the payments SDK should we pull in?

expect.behavior: checks the package's declared peer or host-framework ranges against what the project has installed before adding it
checks the registry's deprecation/yank flag and treats a deprecated package as needing a replacement rather than installing it
verifies the project still builds and runs with the integration's env unset
records the chosen version, pin style, release date, and why in the commit or PR body

reject: installs a next/beta/canary tag by accident
recommends a package the registry flags as deprecated
leaves the pin rationale out of the commit body
